description: EMI Radiated Emissions Estimator. Runs server-side on rftools.io as an async job. Time budget 240 s. Returns a summarised result; ask for full for everything.

cableLen_m.description: Cable Length (m). Length of the longest unshielded cable attached to the PCB. min 0.01, max 10. omit for the default of 0.5

cmCurrent_uA.description: CM Cable Current (peak) (µA). Common-mode current on attached cables. Even µA levels can dominate emissions. min 0.001, max 10000. omit for the default of 1

dmCurrent_mA.description: DM Loop Current (peak) (mA). Peak current circulating in the PCB loop (e.g., power rail decoupling current). min 0.001, max 1000. omit for the default of 10

dutyCycle.description: Duty Cycle (%). 50% duty cycle suppresses even harmonics. Other values can excite them. min 1, max 99. omit for the default of 50

fClk_MHz.description: Clock Frequency (MHz). Fundamental clock frequency. Harmonics are computed up to 1 GHz. min 1, max 2000. omit for the default of 100

full.description: Return the whole result payload instead of the summary. Large.

loopArea_cm2.description: Loop Area (cm²). Area of the current loop on the PCB. Smaller = less DM radiation. min 0.001, max 1000. omit for the default of 1

measDist.description: Measurement Distance (m). FCC Class B: 3 m. FCC Class A / CISPR: 10 m. Limits scale automatically. min 1, max 30. omit for the default of 3

nTrials.description: Monte Carlo Trials. More trials = tighter confidence intervals. 100K is a good balance. min 1000, max 500000. omit for the default of 100000

randomSeed.description: Random Seed. Blank derives the seed from the parameters, so the same job repeats exactly. Set it to draw a different sample of the same design. min 0. Advanced — most callers can leave it out

standard.description: Regulatory Standard. omit for the default of "fcc_b"

tRise_ns.description: Rise Time (ns). Signal 10%–90% rise time. Longer rise times reduce high-frequency harmonics. min 0.1, max 100. omit for the default of 1

waitSeconds.description: How long to wait for the result before returning the job id (0 = submit and return at once, max 600).

name: simulate_emi_radiated
title: EMI Radiated Emissions Estimator
